info.title: Learn English with Play API
info.description: Backend for Learn English with Play. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents (`application/problem+json`) whose `type` is a stable slug; every response carries `X-Request-ID`.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up
Readiness: PostgreSQL and Redis answer

post.summary: Create an account and sign in
Sign in (OAuth 2.0 password grant, form-encoded)
Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair (rotation)
End the session that owns this refresh token
Email a link to set a new password (the answer is the same for any address)
Set a new password from an emailed link; every session of the account ends

get.summary: The signed-in learner

post.summary: Change the password; the sessions on other devices end, this one stays

get.summary: The course map: sections, units and nodes (no items)
One unit: nodes with their items, vocabulary, grammar, story
Every content file with its SHA-256 and URL (docs/11 §3), or nothing when unchanged

parameters.name: since

schema.description: The content version the device holds; omit for all.
schema.title: Since

parameters.description: The content version the device holds; omit for all.

post.summary: Replay the outbox: a batch of answers and disputes, idempotent on client_uuid
One answer (or dispute), graded and scheduled now

get.summary: XP, the daily goal, the streak, gems and quests — secondary to coverage

post.summary: Repair a broken streak: within 48 h, after a double session today, once a month, free
Pause the streak for illness or a holiday: 1–30 days, no questions asked
End a pause early
The kind reset message was shown; stop sending it
These passport stamps were celebrated; do not celebrate them again

patch.summary: Change the daily goal, rest days, retention preset and other account settings
patch.description:
Lowering the daily goal never costs anything (docs/10 §5). A new retention preset
re-derives every due date from the stored stability, so a replay still matches.

Leagues (docs/16 E23) are joined here, never by the server: refused for a learner who might
be under 18, and only with a display name, which may come in the same request. Leaving takes
the learner out of this week's group at once and keeps their tier for four weeks.

get.summary: This week's league: the group, the learner's tier, and an unseen result
The learner's settled weeks, newest first

post.summary: The week's result was shown; stop returning it

get.summary: Coverage first, then the level, the path and the passport (docs/10 §4.1)
The Word Garden at a glance: what is thirsty and how the plants are growing
The garden's beds, one per unit, ten per page
What the scheduler wants reviewed now, each with an exercise to review it
What one lesson session earned: answers, XP and the node-tiers it completed

post.summary: Start a unit test-out: twelve items, 85 % passes, free and unlimited
Grade a test-out from its synced answers; a pass completes the unit
Start 'Find your level': an adaptive search, five items a stage
Answer a placement stage; returns the next stage or the result

get.summary: Cosmetics for gems you earned

post.summary: Buy a cosmetic with earned gems
Wear or use a cosmetic you own (one per slot)

get.summary: Whether the partner is available, and today's allowance
The characters met by a unit, and scenarios from it and the two before (capped at the furthest unit the learner has reached)

post.summary: Start a conversation with a character about a unit's scenario (idempotent by client_uuid)
Say something; the character replies (idempotent by client_uuid; 409 ai_busy while the reply is being written)
End the chat: goal, two things to work on, words used, XP

get.summary: The transcript (yours to read or export until it is deleted)

delete.summary: Delete a conversation and its transcript now

post.summary: Compose a session: warm-up, due reviews, new or lesson material, a close

get.summary: Resume a composed session

post.summary: Close a session (idempotent); what it earned is at /sessions/{id}/summary
Start a level exam: the listening, reading and use-of-English papers
Score the exam from the answers synced under its id (idempotent)

get.summary: The full report on a completed level exam (docs/12 §9.2)
The writing tasks for a level

schema.title: Response Writing Tasks V1 Assessment Writing Tasks Get

post.summary: Submit a writing task; it is rated once, with evidence for every criterion
Appeal a score (once): a human rater who does not see the machine score

get.summary: The four conditions of a level award, each with its computed value

post.summary: Ask for the level: evaluated now, stored with its evidence, awarded only if all hold
Start the monthly retention check: 20 known items, cold
Compare actual recall with the prediction; raise the retention target if needed

get.summary: An audio file's status: missing, a synthetic draft, or a human recording
An audio file

post.summary: Synthesised speech for a short text (server-side; cached; a daily ceiling)

get.summary: The speaking tasks for a level

schema.title: Response Speaking Tasks V1 Assessment Speaking Tasks Get

post.summary: Upload an utterance (with consent); it is scored after this returns — poll the job

get.summary: A recording's scoring job
Everything the server holds about you, as JSON (recordings as base64)

schema.title: Response Export Data V1 Me Export Get

post.summary: Delete the account and everything in it (password required)

get.summary: The next five units (with hashes) and the reviews due in the next seven days

parameters.name: since

get.summary: Which optional features this server has configured

post.summary: Count events only the device can see (an allow-list; nothing personal)

no_vision.title: No Vision
no_vision.description: The learner cannot use the screen.

A11yProfileIn.title: A11yProfileIn
A11yProfileIn.description: docs/00 §6: no exercise type may be the only route to an item.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when the server has no model configured.

retention_days.title: Retention Days
retention_days.description: Transcripts are deleted after this many days.

source.title: Source
source.description: synthetic: a machine voice — the app tells the learner.

url.title: Url
url.description: Where to fetch it; null while it does not exist.

AwardsOut.title: AwardsOut
AwardsOut.description: What the answers in one request earned. Empty when nothing new happened.

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes: keep a cached copy while equal.

url.title: Url
url.description: Where to fetch it: an immutable CDN URL keyed by the hash, or the API path.

ai_partner.title: Ai Partner
ai_partner.description: The conversation partner and the writing rater.

web_refresh_cookie.title: Web Refresh Cookie
web_refresh_cookie.description: A web client may keep its refresh token in an httpOnly cookie.

breached_password_check.title: Breached Password Check
breached_password_check.description: How new passwords are screened (NIST SP 800-63B §5.1.1.2).

normal_per_day.title: Normal Per Day
normal_per_day.description: A normal day of reviews at the learner's daily goal.

days_left.title: Days Left
days_left.description: Honest 'catching up: n days left'; 0 without a backlog.

new_allowed.title: New Allowed
new_allowed.description: False while the backlog is over 3x a normal day.

ai.title: Ai
ai.description: Always true: an AI character, not a person.

checkpoint_id.title: Checkpoint Id
checkpoint_id.description: Send the answers through POST /v1/sync/reviews with this as session_id.

shortfall.title: Shortfall
shortfall.description: What is short and by how much; empty when passed.

unchanged.title: Unchanged
unchanged.description: True when `since` is the current content version: nothing to download.

course.description: The course outline; null when unchanged.

units.title: Units
units.description: Every unit, in course order; empty when unchanged.

starters.title: Starters
starters.description: Phrases from the unit for the Help button.

content_version.title: Content Version
content_version.description: Hash of the content served; the app sends it with every answer.

known_lexemes.title: Known Lexemes
known_lexemes.description: Lexemes whose weakest exercised aspect is retained (S ≥ 21 d) — docs/08 §3.

estimate_percent.title: Estimate Percent
estimate_percent.description: About how much of everyday English the known words cover. An estimate (Zipf over the course order) until the monthly retention audit has run.

audited.title: Audited
audited.description: True while a memory check finished within the last 35 days: what counts as known has been checked against what the learner recalled (docs/08 §9).

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: The learner's own sentences that anchored the band.

item_id.title: Item Id
item_id.description: An exercise that reviews it, not the type used last time.

item_id.title: Item Id
item_id.description: An exercise that reviews it (null when no item does), chosen as for GET /v1/reviews/due but only from units the learner has reached.

papers.title: Papers
papers.description: Paper → item ids. Answer them through POST /v1/sync/reviews with session_id = id.

ends_at.title: Ends At
ends_at.description: Answers the server receives after this do not count (docs/12 §4.1 timings).

reused.title: Reused
reused.description: True when the form had to reuse items from an earlier exam (no exam bank).

overall.title: Overall
overall.description: The mean of the papers; read it with the papers.

error_norms.title: Error Norms
error_norms.description: Level norms need answers from many learners; none exist yet, so none are shown (always null).

work_on.title: Work On
work_on.description: At most five targets, most often wrong first.

note.title: Note
note.description: docs/12 §4: every result says so in plain language.
note.default: An internal assessment, not an accredited qualification.

ExamReportOut.title: ExamReportOut
ExamReportOut.description:
docs/12 §9.2 — and §9.3: no comparison with others, no unexplained single score, no
external band, no number the evidence does not support.

scores.title: Scores
scores.description: Paper → share right; unanswered counts as wrong.

reading_target_wpm.title: Reading Target Wpm
reading_target_wpm.description: docs/06 §1.2, at the top of the level.

speech_target_wpm.title: Speech Target Wpm
speech_target_wpm.description: docs/06 §1.3, at the top of the level.

speech_rate_wpm.title: Speech Rate Wpm
speech_rate_wpm.description: Measured once recorded speech is scored; never estimated.

gems.title: Gems
gems.description: Earned only; spendable on cosmetics, never on learning.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: seed, sprout, bush, bloom, tree, leech, paused.

audited.title: Audited
audited.description: As for the coverage: a memory check in the last 35 days.

goal_min.title: Goal Min
goal_min.description: The learner's own daily goal: 5, 10, 20 or 40 minutes.

minutes_today.title: Minutes Today
minutes_today.description: Time on task today (answers plus reading feedback).

met_now.title: Met Now
met_now.description: Met by the answers in this request.

memory_items.title: Memory Items
memory_items.description: One review-log row per entry (backend brief §3.2).

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: 1 Clay … 10 Diamond; the app names them.

moved.title: Moved
moved.description: 0 also when the streak was paused.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: The name the learner chose to be seen by.

weekly_xp.title: Weekly Xp
weekly_xp.description: XP from scheduled work and immersion; re-grind is 0.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: Where this place would go if the week ended now: the top 7 move up; from tier 3 the bottom 5 move down; tiers 1 and 2 never move down.

opted_in.title: Opted In
opted_in.description: Off by default and never turned on by the server.

eligible.title: Eligible
eligible.description: False for a learner who might be under 18.

week_ends_at.title: Week Ends At
week_ends_at.description: Sunday 20:00 in Tashkent, the same for everyone.

league.description: This week's group; none until the learner's first XP of the week.

result.description: The last settled week, until the app has shown it (POST /result-seen).

is_minor.title: Is Minor
is_minor.description: Derived: true while the learner might be under 18 (year-only birth date).

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Seen by others only in a league the learner joined.

rest_days.title: Rest Days
rest_days.description: ISO weekdays, 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday; at most 2

league_tier.title: League Tier
league_tier.description: 1 Clay … 10 Diamond; kept 4 weeks after leaving.

voice_consent.title: Voice Consent
voice_consent.description: Agreed to voice recording and scoring (kept 30 days at most).

training_opt_in.title: Training Opt In
training_opt_in.description: A separate, explicit opt-in to recordings improving the scorer; off by default.

a11y_no_audio.title: A11Y No Audio
a11y_no_audio.description: Choose exercises that need no hearing: sound-only types are never chosen, listening types only when nothing else reviews the item.

a11y_no_vision.title: A11Y No Vision
a11y_no_vision.description: Choose exercises that need no sight: the visual-memory game and the timed race only when nothing else reviews the item.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: All four, each with its computed value.

message.title: Message
message.description: The honest docs/12 §4.3 message when the exam passed on fragile memory.

recorded.title: Recorded
recorded.description: True when this evaluation was stored as evidence.

cefr.title: Cefr
cefr.description: The sub-level of the learner's current unit.

definition_en.title: Definition En
definition_en.description: Null for most lexemes below B2 (brief §14.4).

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Required, except for a web client using the refresh cookie.

score.title: Score
score.description: Share of the paper's items answered right.

overall_bar.title: Overall Bar
overall_bar.description: The overall share the level asks for.

band.title: Band
band.description: secure: 10 points or more above the overall bar; pass: at or above it; borderline: above the paper bar only; below: under the paper bar.

median_seconds.title: Median Seconds
median_seconds.description: Median seconds per answer on this paper.

new_password.title: New Password
new_password.description: 10 to 256 characters; common and breached passwords are refused.

expires_in_minutes.title: Expires In Minutes
expires_in_minutes.description: How long an emailed link works.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: The same for every address: the answer never says whether it has an account.
detail.default: If an account uses this address, a link to set a new password is on its way.

new_password.title: New Password
new_password.description: 10 to 256 characters; common and breached passwords are refused.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: item_id → the submission, in the outbox's shape.

unit_ids.title: Unit Ids
unit_ids.description: The units this stage's items come from, to load.

result_unit.title: Result Unit
result_unit.description: Where to start: the first unit of that level.

aspects.title: Aspects
aspects.description: aspect → mastery state of that memory item.

units.title: Units
units.description: Units with any completed node, in course order.

start.title: Start
start.description: Where the corrected form sits in the reply, in UTF-16 code units (JavaScript string indices), so emoji before it do not shift the underline.

status.title: Status
status.description: duplicate: this client_uuid was ingested before; nothing was written again.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Why a record was rejected: unknown_item, invalid_submission.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Required, except for a web client using the refresh cookie.

password.title: Password
password.description: 10 to 256 characters. No composition rules (NIST SP 800-63B).

l1.title: L1
l1.description: First language as a language tag, e.g. uz or ru.

birth_year.title: Birth Year
birth_year.description: Year only; used for the 13+ gate and minor protections.

tz.title: Tz
tz.description: IANA time zone; decides where the learner's day starts.

spelling_variant.title: Spelling Variant
spelling_variant.description: docs/00 §2.1: the learner picks US or UK spelling.

item_ids.title: Item Ids
item_ids.description: Answer through POST /v1/sync/reviews with session_id = id.

predicted.title: Predicted
predicted.description: Recall the memory model predicts for these items now.

raised_retention.title: Raised Retention
raised_retention.description: Set when recall was materially below the prediction and the desired retention stepped up.

submission.title: Submission
submission.description: The answer as the outbox stores it: {kind: choice|text|tiles|order|pairs|bins|speech|timeout, …}. Never a recording.

overall.title: Overall
overall.description: Median of the criteria, capped by any weak criterion.

rater.title: Rater
rater.description: Rater kind and version, e.g. llm / claude:…:writing-rater-…

certifying.title: Certifying
certifying.description: False: formative feedback only (the rater is not calibrated at κ ≥ 0.75).

borderline.title: Borderline
borderline.description: Within 5 % of the level's band: a human checks it.

deferred.title: Deferred
deferred.description: Items chosen but left out because no position kept the interleaving rules.

recovery.title: Recovery
recovery.description: Up to two items the learner is almost sure to get right (p ≥ 0.95, nothing new, not in the plan): when the last answer before CLOSE was wrong, play one first, so a session never ends on a failure (docs/07 §3.2). Not part of `estimated_seconds`.

withheld.title: Withheld
withheld.description: Lesson items the accessibility profile has no form for, left out of the plan. The node-tier is passed on the items that can be shown.

a11y_profile.description: The profile the exercises were chosen for.

catching_up.description: Present on a newly composed session.

new_cap.title: New Cap
new_cap.description: New targets allowed a day at this level.

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.description: How long the learner wants to practise.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: Play this lesson node; omit for free practice (reviews plus new material).

a11y_profile.description: Choose exercises for this profile; omitted: the profile saved in settings (`a11y_no_audio`, `a11y_no_vision`).

role.title: Role
role.description: warmup: an easy start; review: due memory; lesson: new or node material; close: the weakest item again, another way; break: 15 seconds of rest; recovery: a near-certain item, played only to keep a session from ending on a failure.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: The part of the session shape it belongs to (docs/07 §3.2). A lesson item is guided practice for the first 60 % of the lesson's practice items, integration after them, production when it is speaking or free writing. No item is new_input: new words and grammar are presented by the app, never tested, before the first lesson item.

seconds.title: Seconds
seconds.description: Expected time, from the learner's own response times.

leagues_opt_in.title: Leagues Opt In
leagues_opt_in.description: Weekly leagues, off by default (docs/16 E23). Refused for a learner who might be under 18 (403 leagues_not_for_minors) and without a display name (409 display_name_required).

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: The name others in a league see: 2–24 letters, digits, spaces, _ - or apostrophes. null removes it (not while in leagues).

voice_consent.title: Voice Consent
voice_consent.description: Withdrawing consent deletes every stored recording.

data_collection_paused.title: Data Collection Paused
data_collection_paused.description: While paused, no recordings or writing are accepted.

a11y_no_audio.title: A11Y No Audio
a11y_no_audio.description: Accessibility: choose exercises that need no hearing.

a11y_no_vision.title: A11Y No Vision
a11y_no_vision.description: Accessibility: choose exercises that need no sight.

note.title: Note
note.description: Gems buy looks only — never lessons, hints, freezes or tests.

value.title: Value
value.description: A share (listening, reading, language) or a rubric band 1–6 (writing, speaking); null when the skill has not been assessed at this level yet.

target.title: Target
target.description: What the level asks for, on the same scale.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: The recording is deleted then, or sooner on request.

result.title: Result
result.description: headline (0–100), passed, at most two notes, per-word scores, transcript; for a speaking task also the rubric score id.

client_uuid.title: Client Uuid
client_uuid.description: The app's id for this start. Retrying with the same id returns the same conversation and is charged once (409 ai_busy while its opening line is being written).

freezes.title: Freezes
freezes.description: Free and automatic: at most 2, one back every 5 days.

rest_days.title: Rest Days
rest_days.description: ISO weekdays that never break the streak.

can_repair.title: Can Repair
can_repair.description: Broken within 48 hours and not repaired this month.

focus_items.title: Focus Items
focus_items.description: Two things to work on, at most.

content_changed.title: Content Changed
content_changed.description: False when `since` is the current content version: cached units are current.

current_unit.title: Current Unit
current_unit.description: Where the learner is on the path.

units.title: Units
units.description: The next five units from the current one, then every other unit the due window reviews — what the device should hold to learn and review offline.

due.title: Due
due.description: Memory items due within the window, soonest first (at most 5,000), each with its exercise: offline, the device reviews those whose due_at has passed.

due_total.title: Due Total
due_total.description: How many are due within the window in all.

due_now.title: Due Now
due_now.description: Memory items due for review at server_time.

units_left.title: Units Left
units_left.description: Units not yet completed up to the end of the next level.

units_per_week.title: Units Per Week
units_per_week.description: Units completed a week, the last 4 weeks.

weeks.title: Weeks
weeks.description: At that pace; null when there is no pace yet.

expires_in.title: Expires In
expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Null when it was set as an httpOnly cookie instead (`X-LEP-Token-Transport: cookie`, web clients only).

refresh_expires_in.title: Refresh Expires In
refresh_expires_in.description: Seconds until the refresh token expires.

client_uuid.title: Client Uuid
client_uuid.description: Retry with the same id: the turn is not repeated.

rt_ms.title: Rt Ms
rt_ms.description: Thinking and typing time, for the goal.

recasts.title: Recasts
recasts.description: Shown during the chat in accuracy mode only.

off_limits.title: Off Limits
off_limits.description: The message asked for something outside the rules (or the model declined): the reply is the fixed safe line, and the turn earns no goals or production XP.

estimate_percent.title: Estimate Percent
estimate_percent.description: About how much of everyday English the known words cover — an estimate.

target.title: Target
target.description: A syllabus target: a lexeme, grammar point, function …

label.title: Label
label.description: The target in words (a headword, a grammar point).

unit_id.title: Unit Id
unit_id.description: The first unit that teaches it: where to practise.
